trials.description: Listed as an 'observational biomarker study' in registry
trials.actual_protocol_details: Despite registry listing as observational, the protocol involves biomarker-guided dose adjustments of azathioprine with a randomized control arm receiving standard dosing. Patients in the intervention arm have their azathioprine dose modified based on thiopurine metabolite levels. This constitutes an interventional trial by FDA definition.
trials.notes: Patient may not be aware this qualifies as an interventional trial. Consent form describes it as a 'monitoring study with possible dose optimization.'
